clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, travelers honor Bloodhoof the Elder just north of Bloodhoof Village. The ancestral spirit appears near the bridge and offers a Coin of Ancestry in return.

During the Lunar Festival, spirits of heroes and elders from ages past return to Azeroth. Elder Bloodhoof appears just north of Bloodhoof Village, near the bridge. Travelers honor the sacrifices of the past by approaching the elder, who offers words of encouragement and a Coin of Ancestry.

On Mulgore's ancestral lands, Elder Bloodhoof links the living tauren tribes with the memory of their forebears. Honoring the dead is central to tauren spiritual life. It keeps the Earth Mother, the ancestors, and those walking the plains in harmony.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your spirit burns with life, young adventurer. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
